description: FERC Form 1 purchased power and exchanges (Schedule 326) for one utility and report year, 1994 to date: each seller (counterparty), purchase type (RQ requirements, LF long-term firm, IF intermediate firm, SF short-term firm, LU long-term unit, OS other/non-firm, EX exchange, AD adjustment), MWh purchased and settlement dollars. Rows sorted by MWh, subtotal rows excluded and reported separately. Answers "who did PacifiCorp buy the most power from in 1994". Source: FERC Form 1 as processed by Catalyst Cooperative PUDL.

purchase_type.description: Optional purchase type code filter, e.g. OS, LF, LU, RQ.

utility.description: FERC Form 1 respondent: a name (e.g. "PacifiCorp") or the numeric FERC respondent id (utility_id_ferc1, e.g. 303). Find ids with ferc1_find_utility.

year.description: Report year (e.g. 2023). Default: the latest year on file for the respondent.

name: ferc1_purchased_power
title: Ferc1 Purchased Power
